chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 528 – The Tides of War: Ji Ning Shatters a White-Faced Flood Dragon
chapter_meta_description: The Xishui Legion is crushed by a super-powered White-Faced Flood Dragon. The Seamless Gate celebrates—until Ji Ning’s Xingtian God turns the tide with brutal skill and cold fury.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch 528 – Ji Ning Turns the Tide
og_description: Ji Ning’s Xingtian God destroys a White-Faced Flood Dragon as war erupts in blood and baleful energy.
twitter_title: War in the Three Realms: Ji Ning Strikes Back
twitter_description: The Seamless Gate is winning, then Ji Ning's knee finds a White-Faced Flood Dragon's face. Battle chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability; its name references the myth of Xingtian, a decapitated god.
A mysterious Empyrean God of the Seamless Gate, whose identity as the commander of the super-powerful White-Faced Flood Dragon was unknown to the Grand Xia.
A violent, chaotic force generated from mass slaughter and death on a battlefield; it can corrupt cultivators but is refined by Ji Ning's Northsea swords.
The Grand Xia Legion whose Xingtian God was the first to be defeated by the Seamless Gate's elite White-Faced Flood Dragon.
One of the Celestial Immortal leaders of the Seamless Gate forces; he devised the tactic of using Venomous Clown to command the White-Faced Flood Dragon.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A war formation that uses 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals to manifest a single, towering divine spirit of god-tier power; it is named after the myth of Xingtian, a decapitated god who continued to fight.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning destroy the White-Faced Flood Dragon?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He feigned weakness with a weaker follow-up attack, then used a devastating knee strike from the Xingtian God's powerful legs to break its stance, followed by piercing its neck with two sharpened longswords.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the white face on the Flood Dragon's chest?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a natural artifact of the ancient formation, revealing who the commander is; the face on the chest cannot be faked or hidden, making it a key intelligence indicator.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happens when a Xingtian God or White-Faced Flood Dragon is destroyed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The formation breaks and all the immortals inside are violently expelled; they become vulnerable and can be easily slaughtered by the enemy commander.
